page.overview:
Who is Whisper?

"Whisper" is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Judge in White, she is a bodyguard of Sadali and is affiliated with the Crystal Sanctum. Her "sisters" are "Grace" and "Murmur".

"Whisper" is a UR-rarity unit of the Dark element whose main job is Knight, while her sub jobs are Samurai and Spellblade. She can equip the following items: Sword, Armor, Helm, Accessory. Her unit cost is 70.

Her Master Ability increases her own Slash Attack by 5 and her Slash/Pierce/Strike/Missile/Magic Attack Resistance by 5%. Her limit burst is White Wave, which deals Dmg (L) to targets within area around self & lowers Bravery.

Her Trust Master Reward is the Magicite Mask accessory which bestows HP +240, TP +15, Slash Attack Res Up 5, Strike Attack Res Up 5, Pierce Attack Res Up 5, Missile Attack Res Up 5 and the Dove's Embrace ability, which consumes own HP to significantly raise ally's DEF/SPR for 1 turn.
